SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT RQDT.BUYER , RQDT.QUOTATION_NO , RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ , RQDT.REVISION FROM KEPRQDT RQDT INNER JOIN KEPQTDT QTDT ON (1 = 1 AND QTDT.BUYER = RQDT.BUYER AND QTDT.QUOTATION_NO = RQDT.QUOTATION_NO AND QTDT.QUOTATION_SEQ = RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ AND QTDT.REVISION = RQDT.REVISION AND QTDT.BID_SUCCESS_FLAG = 'Y' ) WHERE RQDT.BUYER = 'KRDOOS0035' AND RQDT.SND_CHK = 'N' AND RQDT.ATOB_SEND_FLAG = 'Y' AND RQDT.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND RQDT.QUOTATION_NO LIKE 'DM%' AND 0 = (SELECT count(*) FROM KEPRQDT WHERE BUYER = RQDT.BUYER AND QUOTATION_NO = RQDT.QUOTATION_NO AND REVISION = RQDT.REVISION AND STATUS IN ('C','R') AND RECV_FLAG <> 'GD' AND ATOB_SEND_FLAG <> 'Y') AND RQDT.RECV_FLAG <> 'GD' ORDER BY RQDT.BUYER , RQDT.QUOTATION_NO , TO_NUMBER(RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ) , RQDT.REVISION
